mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teacher (real_name, university, major, user_id) VALUES (#{realName}, #{university}, #{major}, #{user_id})
mapper.select: select teacher.id from teacher where user_id = #{currentUserId};

SELECT t.* FROM teacher t LEFT JOIN teacher_subject ts ON t.id = ts.teacher_id LEFT JOIN subject s ON ts.subject_id = s.id
AND t.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{realName}, '%')
AND s.subject_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{subject}, '%')
GROUP BY t.id LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) FROM teacher t LEFT JOIN teacher_subject ts ON t.id = ts.teacher_id LEFT JOIN subject s ON ts.subject_id = s.id
AND t.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{realName}, '%')
AND s.subject_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{subject}, '%')
